issues.description: Method mismatch: PersonResource.createPerson has different declared return types in template vs solution. In the template (src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/rest/PersonResource.java) the method signature is: public ResponseEntity<Person> createPerson(@RequestBody Person person) — it returns ResponseEntity<Person>. In the solution (src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/rest/PersonResource.java) the signature is: public void createPerson(@RequestBody Person person) — it returns void. This structural inconsistency (method return type) may confuse students comparing template and reference code when checking controller API design and expected response bodies.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the createPerson method signature consistent between template and solution. Either change the solution to return ResponseEntity<Person> and return ResponseEntity.ok(savedPerson) (if the exercise intends to return the created entity in the response body), or change the template to use void (and omit returning the entity) if the exercise intentionally expects no response body. Update any tests or documentation accordingly so controller contract is unambiguous.
